summary: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) filed an 8-K regarding its wholly-owned subsidiaries' receipt of requisite consents to amend indentures governing 16 series of senior notes via consent solicitations that commenced May 19, 2026 and expired May 26, 2026. The supplemental indentures were executed and delivered, becoming effective upon execution but operative only when the consent payment is made, expected May 29, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is present; this is a routine debt management action to modify covenant terms. The filing constitutes an ordinary current report with no special situation implications.
